title: RMSNorm with a residual, head norms with rotary positions, gated norms, activation products and residual-stream mixes, one Triton launch a call

rows.what: one-pass row norms (rms_norm with or without a residual, rms_norm_heads, gated_rms_norm, l2_norm, stream_add_norm): a program holds HB rows of BD = the width rounded up to a power of two values, FP32 sums of squares in the order that layout gives them

ELEMENTS.what: values a program holds: HB = max(1, ELEMENTS / BD) rows a program

SPAN.what: values a warp covers: num_warps = BD * HB / SPAN, 1 to 16

yardstick.library: FlashInfer gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm (with a residual, in place, on a BF16 copy of the FP32 residual: it keeps the residual in the rows' dtype) or gemma_rmsnorm (without), the weight in BF16

rope.what: rotary positions on heads, alone or after their norm (rope, rms_norm_rope) and the query/key pair in one launch (rope_pair, rms_norm_rope_pair): a program holds up to HB heads of one token, BD values each

ELEMENTS.what: values a program holds: HB = max(1, ELEMENTS / BD) heads a program, at most the heads rounded up to a power of two

SPAN.what: values a warp covers: num_warps = BD * HB / SPAN, 1 to 16

yardstick.library: FlashInfer gemma_rmsnorm of the queries and of the keys, then apply_rope_pos_ids_inplace (three launches: no FlashInfer call fuses head norms with 1-D rotary positions); apply_rope_pos_ids alone without the norms

long-rows.what: norms of rows wider than 16,384 values: one row a program, held in registers and read once (CHUNK 0 up to 32,768 values, or a CHUNK at least the row's block), else in two passes of CHUNK values (the sums of squares, then the normalized row)

CHUNK.what: values a pass step reads; the sums of squares accumulate CHUNK lanes (0: the row's block, its width rounded up to a power of two, in one pass up to 32,768 values, else 4,096 in two passes; a CHUNK at least the row's block: one pass)

WARPS.what: warps a program (0: 16 in one pass, 8 in two)

PDL.what: one-pass rows: programmatic dependent launch on sm_90 and newer (0: none; 1, 2, 3: wait for the kernel before, then let the next start after this program's loads, its stores, or its exit): speed only

yardstick.library: FlashInfer gemma_rmsnorm (gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm with a residual, on a BF16 copy of it), the weight in BF16

act-mul.what: activation products (silu_mul, gelu_mul, sigmoid_mul): BLOCK values of one row a program, elementwise

PDL.what: programmatic dependent launch on sm_90 and newer (0: none; 1, 2, 3: wait for the kernel before, then let the next start after this program's loads, its stores, or its exit): speed only

yardstick.library: FlashInfer silu_and_mul (its programmatic dependent launch on, as it runs by default)

stream-sum.what: the gated, weighted or plain sum over a token's residual streams in stream order (stream_sum): BLOCK values of one token a program

yardstick.library: torch ops (x * g[..., None]).sum(1) in FP32 and a cast: no library fuses a weighted sum over residual streams

stream-add.what: one row added into every residual stream with a weight per stream, in place (stream_add): BLOCK values of one token a program

yardstick.library: torch ops h.add_(w[..., None] * x[:, None]): no library adds a row into weighted residual streams

softplus-decay.what: a gated delta or state-space layer's log-decay -rate * softplus(x + bias) and sigmoid gate (softplus_decay): BLOCK values of one token a program

yardstick.library: torch ops -rate * softplus(x + bias) and sigmoid(gate) in FP32: no library computes a gated delta layer's decay and beta on their own
